title: Business Central Trivia Recap: October 5–9, 2026
summary: A recap of a Business Central trivia quiz event covering October 5-9, 2026, with 250 questions, 58% average correct answers, and statistics on which categories were hardest and easiest.
key_points: The trivia event had 250 questions across five days with an overall 58% correct answer rate, the lowest recorded
Subscription Billing was the hardest category at 36% correct, while Name That Page was easiest at 77%
Sustainability and Fixed Assets were among the hardest categories, with Sustainability being difficult in consecutive weeks
Site improvements included a username validation system and visual enhancements to the page header

quotes.text: 58% of the answers were correct, down from 61% last week.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates this was the most challenging trivia round, helping track engagement difficulty trends

quotes.text: Sustainability was the hardest category last week too.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that Sustainability topics consistently challenge participants, suggesting they need more learning resources
